rows.claim: Venus command serialization wire-format correctness
rows.workload: libukvenus: PACKED encoding + uint32 array_size per Mesa vn_encode_array_size()
rows.required_evidence: vulkan_registry_check (9 command IDs vs vk.xml/Mesa/VK_EXT_command_serialization.xml); venus_cs_test encoding layout assertions for all bootstrap commands
rows.claim_allowed: Venus encoder uses PACKED wire format (no inter-field alignment padding; uint64 not 8-byte aligned in stream); array presence fields are uint32 array_size per Mesa protocol, not uint64 pointer flags. Commands match vk.xml and Mesa vn_protocol_driver_defines.h. Encoding is parseable by virglrenderer's vkr_context_submit_cmd.
rows.claim_forbidden: GPU acceleration, rendering, or Vulkan conformance; registry check validates IDs only, not runtime correctness.
rows.next_step: Keep as regression gate; rerun vulkan_registry_check after any venus.h ID changes.
